## Description

Programme: MDV-P1-E12 · UX programme: safe, cohesive clinic workspace (from the Nov 2026 product UX audit). Track D (design rules and UI component setup), wave D3. This is audit backlog UX-20 of the Nov 2026 product UX audit (an audit id, not an MDV key).

Persona and route: /patients/new first; then settings, onboarding, the pregnancy card, sign-up, the platform console · receptionist, admin, owner.
Findings and reviewers: F-23 · reviewers B-13, B-21, C-12. Part 2 of 2 of audit backlog UX-20.
Rationale: After an empty submit on registration, focus stays on the button and at 375 px the errors are off screen. The pregnancy card's message is generic and not linked to a field.
Proposed UX behaviour: One feature per pull request, in this order: registration, settings, onboarding and sign-up, the pregnancy card, the platform console. Each form uses Field for every control and shows ErrorSummary after a failed submit, with focus on it. Each form picks one required or optional convention. Buttons that were disabled from the start with no reason (Check in now on walk-in) are enabled and validate on press, or show the reason beside them. The duplicate block at registration and the identity confirmation at check-in are untouched. The ratchet count for local Field components falls to zero and the lint rule turns to error.
Prototype and blueprint reference: docs/product-ux-audit/08-design-system-blueprint.md section 9.
Components and tokens affected: Field, ErrorSummary. Removes five local Field wrappers.
Front end and back end split: Front end only. Zod schemas stay in domain.
Prerequisites and blocked by: Blocked by the Field and ErrorSummary component ticket. Timing: after the first pilot weeks, or before the first staff training session if the founder moves it there; never between training and the first two pilot weeks (arbitration ruling 6).
Clinical sign-off: Not required. The duplicate block and identity confirmation must not change (do-not-change list).
Effort and regression risk: M · Medium: registration is on the walk-in path; its click count is re-measured.
Deliberately NOT in this ticket: (1) Changing any validation rule or required field. (2) Date pickers in the app language.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given Register patient submitted empty at 375 px and 1440 px, when the submit fails, then focus is on the summary, it is in the viewport, and each link moves focus to its field
- [ ] **AC2.** Given each migrated form, when it renders, then required or optional is marked one way throughout, in words
- [ ] **AC3.** Given walk-in before a patient is chosen, when Check in now is pressed or read, then the reason is stated in words
- [ ] **AC4.** Given registration and check-in, when a duplicate or an identity confirmation applies, then they behave exactly as before, and the walk-in path is at most 6 clicks new and 3 returning
- [ ] **AC5.** Given features, when searched, then no local Field component remains and the lint rule is an error
- [ ] **AC6.** Given English and Arabic, when axe runs on each migrated form with errors showing, then there is no violation
